title: Link Access Check
description: Prevents "I can't open the link" and accidental public sharing by checking every Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Notion, Figma or Box link in a message against its recipients before it is sent, naming who can't open each one with one-tap fixes (give view access, open it to the company, or ask the owner when you can't share it), and warning when an anyone-with-the-link doc is going outside the organisation.
stops: Shared a link they can't open
mistakes: recipient can't open google drive link
